capabilities: display the current Vim mode in the status bar
color-code each mode with a configurable background color
switch between full (NORMAL) and abbreviated (N) display formats
disambiguation: Does not provide Vim keybindings or editing behavior; it only displays the mode reported by Obsidian's built-in Vim mode.
intentEvidence: A simple Obsidian plugin that displays the current Vim mode in your status bar with customizable colors.
problem: Obsidian's built-in Vim mode gives no visible indication of the current mode, making it hard to tell which mode you are in.
summary: Status bar indicator that displays the current Vim mode (Normal, Insert, Visual, Replace, Command) with customizable colors.
